verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a cloud-hosted AI coding assistant, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, region selection, or where data is stored. The training opt-out (docs-12) is a different privacy control and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
